title: General.
officialText:
Pipe supports shall be in accordance with Section 305. Piping serving equipment at levels above the lowest floor or
storage tanks at levels above the lowest floor in buildings shall also comply with the requirements of Sections 1305.9.6 and 1305.9.7.
SECTION MC 1305
FUEL-OIL SYSTEM INSTALLATION
